scope.derivative_note: Beginning crops enlarge already-rendered annotated clip pixels 3x by nearest interpolation for display. This adds no identity detail; annotation and lossy clip compression limit interpretation.
scope.record_review: Independent audit covers full software records, plus source-index paired traces for five 30-frame bursts. Full software audit is not full physical identity annotation.

cases.finding: The same visible red scooter retains concurrent motorcycle boxes/IDs in both variants. ReID does not resolve this observed duplicate-track case.

cases.finding: The same source-linked component/class handoff occurs with ReID off and on. Appearance does not stabilize physical component/category assignment in this reviewed case.
cases.interpretation_limit: This is not a formally labeled whole-video ID-switch score or an accepted pedestrian/rider category mapping.

cases.finding: The same respective ID returns after five absent assignments in both variants; this recovery was already present without ReID.
cases.interpretation_limit: One retained recovery does not establish general recovery reliability or the physical cause of absent assignments.

cases.finding: ON ID6 becomes confirmed at frame11 and reacquires source-linked small car detections at16,19,29; OFF creates fresh unconfirmed IDs on these observations. Saved cost traces confirm appearance lowers the association cost here.
cases.physical_identity_conclusion: UNESTABLISHED: candidate is about33x20 native pixels and partly label-covered. No apparent relocation onto the larger carID1 or adjacentID2 is visible, but the pixels cannot reliably establish same-car identity or a quality gain.

cases.finding: Receding rider/motorcycle components show local continuity at displayed positions in both variants (off933/935, on483/485). The end distant car likewise retains local continuity (off4829, on2327). Sparse displayed positions do not establish every intervening frame.
